question: What are the most influential papers on organoid disease models? Return 5 with DOIs and citation counts.

{"answer":"The most influential papers on organoid disease models span pancreatic, prostate, liver, airway, and cancer organoid systems. The top five by citation count (excluding off-topic results) are: (1) a landmark Cell paper establishing pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma organoid models from human and mouse tissue; (2) a Nature Reviews Cancer comprehensive review of organoids in cancer research; (3) a Cell paper on patient-derived prostate cancer organoids; (4) a Nature Medicine paper on human primary liver cancer organoids for disease modeling and drug screening; and (5) an EMBO Journal paper on long-term expanding human airway organoids for disease modeling — all confirmed as top-1% C3 influence class or among the highest cited in the field.","citations":[{"doi":"10.1016/j.cell.2014.12.021","title":"Organoid Models of Human and Mouse Ductal Pancreatic Cancer","citation_count":1961},{"doi":"10.1038/s41568-018-0007-6","title":"Organoids in cancer research","citation_count":1548},{"doi":"10.1016/j.cell.2014.08.016","title":"Organoid Cultures Derived from Patients with Advanced Prostate Cancer","citation_count":1402},{"doi":"10.1038/nm.4438","title":"Human primary liver cancer–derived organoid cultures for disease modeling and drug screening","citation_count":1282},{"doi":"10.15252/embj.2018100300","title":"Long‐term expanding human airway organoids for disease modeling","citation_count":938}]}
